root.text: Keep your hands where I can see them. Crowns speak clearer than promises.

variants.text: You silenced it? I will give you fair prices today. Do not make me regret saying that.
I have not forgotten your cruelty. Speak honestly this time.
The shrine has answered. Hollowmere remembers what you have done. Back again? Good. People who return are better customers.
Back again? Good. People who return are better customers.

choices.text: What do you know of the Veil?
I heard the bell has fallen silent.
I would like to sell something.

identity.text: Mara. If you came for charity, try the chapel. If you came for supplies, we can talk.

past.text: I buried my partner when the caravans stopped. This stall is the only thing the Veil has not taken from me.

choices.text: What do you hear about the others?

town.text: The town grew around the road and its tollhouse. Now the road brings nobody, and the toll is paid in memories.

king.text: The king paid his debts with promises. You cannot eat a promise.

stay.text: Because leaving means trusting a road. Here I can at least see who owes me.

rumors.text: Brann lets his forge burn all night. Says it keeps the dead away. I think he simply cannot bear the dark.

veil.text: Nobody buys from a dead merchant. I trade in daylight and bar my door when the bell stirs.

choices.text: What do you know of the shrine?

bell.text: A very large bell, a very small space to stand safely. Get out of its marked circle. Hit it while it hauls itself upright. Simple advice; expensive to ignore.

dangers.text: Keep to the forest road. The east gate needs a sigil. That sentinel has one, if you can persuade it to stop breathing.

shrine.text: There is a crystal beyond the crypt. If it offers you a fortune, check what it asks in return.

boss.text: You silenced it? I will give you fair prices today. Do not make me regret saying that.

medicine.text: Mara sells draughts by the square. The blue crystals restore your strength for free. Do not mistake endurance for wisdom.

discovery.text: Keep to the forest road. The east gate needs a sigil. That sentinel has one, if you can persuade it to stop breathing. The eastern crypt gate will answer that sigil now.

root.text: The bell broke. My anvil did not. Bring iron and I will make you dangerous.

variants.text: The anvil sounds louder without that damned bell. Good work, wanderer.
I have not forgotten your cruelty. Speak honestly this time.
The shrine has answered. Hollowmere remembers what you have done. Still holding that blade? Let us keep it worth holding.
Still holding that blade? Let us keep it worth holding.

choices.text: What do you know of the Veil?

identity.text: Brann. Blacksmith, grave digger when needed, and a poor liar. Your blade looks tired.

past.text: I forged the old garrison's swords. Most came back without their owners. I still work the iron because stopping would mean listening.

choices.text: What do you hear about the others?

town.text: The king wanted iron from these hills. Hollowmere fed his armies until his armies came home hollow.

king.text: His crest was stamped on every sword. None of those swords could cut a curse.

stay.text: Someone must keep their tools sharp. Someone must be here when they return.

rumors.text: Mara knows which roads are still safe. She pretends she does not care who returns from them.

veil.text: The curse has found its way into grave iron. Heat it long enough and it starts to sing. Bring me three pieces; I will pay you.

choices.text: What do you know of the shrine?

bell.text: Watch the ground, not its face. Leave the marked circle, wait for the crash, then hit the joints before it recovers.

dangers.text: The sentinel wears good iron. The hound in the southwest wears none; it is no less dangerous. Keep your edge ready.

shrine.text: No hammer I own can cut that shrine’s stone. Whatever waits there, you will need more than a weapon.

boss.text: The anvil sounds louder without that damned bell. Good work, wanderer.

medicine.text: Mara sells draughts by the square. The blue crystals restore your strength for free. Do not mistake endurance for wisdom.

work.text: Bring three Grave Iron to Brann. I offer 40 Crowns and 60 XP.

variants.text: You have done what I asked. Your promised reward has been paid; I will remember your help.
The work is not forgotten. Bring three Grave Iron to Brann.

choices.text: I have brought what you asked for.

materials.text: Grave Iron comes from the old guardians and forest creatures. Bring three pieces for the job; upgrades use additional iron.

discovery.text: The sentinel wears good iron. The hound in the southwest wears none; it is no less dangerous. Keep your edge ready. The eastern crypt gate will answer that sigil now.

root.text: Sit. Your wounds are honest, even if your memories are not.

variants.text: The fever has broken in two houses. Whatever awaits at the shrine, remember this mercy.
I have not forgotten your cruelty. Speak honestly this time.
The shrine has answered. Hollowmere remembers what you have done. Welcome back. Tell me where it hurts, or what you have learned.
Welcome back. Tell me where it hurts, or what you have learned.

choices.text: What do you know of the Veil?

identity.text: Elowen. I tend the sick and keep the chapel open. Names are easier to mend than memories.

past.text: I once tended the keeper of the bell. He asked me to forget his face. I have tried, wanderer. I have tried.

choices.text: What do you hear about the others?

town.text: There was a spring under this chapel. Pilgrims came for its water. The first bell was meant to guide them home.

king.text: He wanted to keep everyone safe. Fear makes that wish dangerous.

stay.text: The sick cannot leave. Neither can I.

rumors.text: Osric has been leaving bread at empty graves. I do not ask whether it is prayer or apology.

veil.text: The herbs ease its fever, but not its dreams. Gather three Weeping Herbs and return them; I will pay 35 Crowns and 60 XP.

choices.text: What do you know of the shrine?

bell.text: You need not endure every blow. Leave the orange circle and let it fall on empty stone. There is time to answer afterward.

dangers.text: Three pale herbs grow beside the forest paths. Avoid the green spirits. A blue crystal can cleanse what follows you home.

shrine.text: The crystal remembers the first keeper. Go gently. You may find a wound that belongs to you.

boss.text: The fever has broken in two houses. Whatever awaits at the shrine, remember this mercy.

medicine.text: Mara sells draughts by the square. The blue crystals restore your strength for free. Do not mistake endurance for wisdom.

work.text: Bring three Weeping Herbs to Sister Elowen. I offer 35 Crowns and 60 XP.

variants.text: You have done what I asked. Your promised reward has been paid; I will remember your help.
The work is not forgotten. Bring three Weeping Herbs to Sister Elowen.

choices.text: I have brought what you asked for.

materials.text: Weeping Herbs grow along the forest paths. Gather three and bring them back. Their pale buds remain visible in the mist.

discovery.text: Three pale herbs grow beside the forest paths. Avoid the green spirits. A blue crystal can cleanse what follows you home. The eastern crypt gate will answer that sigil now.

root.text: Something wore my brother’s face in the woods. Please find his charm.

variants.text: You brought him home, in the only way left to us. I will not forget.
You kept the last piece of him. I paid what I promised. Do not ask for my trust.
I dreamed of my brother without the forest behind him. Thank you.
I have not forgotten your cruelty. Speak honestly this time.
The shrine has answered. Hollowmere remembers what you have done. You came back. That means more than you think.
You came back. That means more than you think.

choices.text: What do you know of the Veil?
I heard the bell has fallen silent.

identity.text: Tovin. My brother used to introduce us both. I still wait for him to do it.

past.text: My brother taught me the southern forest path. I cannot walk it now without expecting his footsteps behind mine.

choices.text: What do you hear about the others?

town.text: It was a small place even then. The forest sounded ordinary. That is what I miss most.

king.text: Kings were stories adults told. My brother was real.

stay.text: If my brother ever finds his way back, someone must answer the door.

rumors.text: Nell keeps my brother’s seat empty. I wish she would stop. I wish she never would.

veil.text: Something came home wearing his face. His Silver Charm is in the southwest forest chest. Bring it back, or tell me honestly why you will not.

choices.text: What do you know of the shrine?

bell.text: I heard it strike the same patch of stone twice. It cannot follow you through every step. Move when the ground glows.

dangers.text: My brother hid things in a chest in the southwest hollow. The hound is still there. Please be careful.

shrine.text: If the shrine returns your memories, hold them carefully. Even the bad ones are yours.

boss.text: I dreamed of my brother without the forest behind him. Thank you.

medicine.text: Mara sells draughts by the square. The blue crystals restore your strength for free. Do not mistake endurance for wisdom.

work.text: Recover the Silver Charm from a forest chest. Return it or keep it. I offer 40 Crowns and 60 XP.

variants.text: You have done what I asked. Your promised reward has been paid; I will remember your help.
The work is not forgotten. Recover the Silver Charm from a forest chest. Return it or keep it.

choices.text: I have brought what you asked for.
I want to keep the charm.

materials.text: The charm lies in a chest in the southwest hollow. You may return it or admit you wish to keep it. My payment is the same; my trust is not.

discovery.text: My brother hid things in a chest in the southwest hollow. The hound is still there. Please be careful. The eastern crypt gate will answer that sigil now.

root.text: The crypt gate needs a sigil. The forest sentinel carries it. End the bell’s silence.

variants.text: The bell is silent. You gave us a morning I thought we had lost. The shrine is open.
I have not forgotten your cruelty. Speak honestly this time.
The shrine has answered. Hollowmere remembers what you have done. Wanderer. Report when you are ready.
Wanderer. Report when you are ready.

identity.text: Captain Ilya. There is no army left to command. Only a square worth defending.

past.text: I held the western bridge until the dead learned to cross the riverbed. Eight of us returned. I do not count myself among the living yet.

choices.text: What do you hear about the others?

town.text: We defended a crossing, then a road, then a village. The kingdom shrank until it fit inside this square.

king.text: I have not seen him since the western bridge. I no longer trust reports of his death.

stay.text: There are still people behind me. That is reason enough.

rumors.text: Vesper arrived before the curse. I have never seen anyone remember his arrival.

veil.text: We can lose the forest or we can lose everyone. Defeat the sentinel for its sigil, then enter the crypt and silence the Bellkeeper.

choices.text: What do you know of the shrine?

bell.text: Its blast is telegraphed. Clear the circle, keep stamina for a dodge, then counter during recovery. Do not trade blows with it.

dangers.text: The eastern sentinel carries the crypt sigil. A lost hound haunts the southwest; a knight guards the crypt. Three enemies, three different rhythms.

shrine.text: The shrine lies beyond the Bellkeeper. Once the guardian falls, I cannot follow you. That last report is yours alone.

boss.text: The bell is silent. You gave us a morning I thought we had lost. The shrine is open.

medicine.text: Mara sells draughts by the square. The blue crystals restore your strength for free. Do not mistake endurance for wisdom.

work.text: Speak to Ilya. Defeat the forest sentinel for the sigil, enter the crypt, silence the Bellkeeper, then visit the shrine. I offer 100 Crowns and 60 XP.

variants.text: You have done what I asked. Your promised reward has been paid; I will remember your help.
The work is not forgotten. Speak to Ilya. Defeat the forest sentinel for the sigil, enter the crypt, silence the Bellkeeper, then visit the shrine.

choices.text: What about the three unquiet souls?

elites.text: The sentinel, the lost hound, and the crypt knight. Lay all three to rest and I will pay 75 Crowns and 60 XP.

variants.text: All three are at peace. Your payment has been made. Thank you.

choices.text: I will lay them to rest.

discovery.text: The eastern sentinel carries the crypt sigil. A lost hound haunts the southwest; a knight guards the crypt. Three enemies, three different rhythms. The eastern crypt gate will answer that sigil now.

root.text: The Veil is a mercy! Or perhaps... I need it to be.

variants.text: I can hear my own prayers again. They sound smaller, but more honest.
I have not forgotten your cruelty. Speak honestly this time.
The shrine has answered. Hollowmere remembers what you have done. I hoped you would return. There are words I should have said sooner.
I hoped you would return. There are words I should have said sooner.

identity.text: Osric. I once called myself a shepherd of souls. These days I mostly lose the flock.

past.text: I prayed for an end to pain. When the Veil came, I mistook silence for an answer. Perhaps I was wrong.

choices.text: What do you hear about the others?

town.text: The bells were blessed before they were weapons. I signed the prayer that hung beside the first one.

king.text: We mistook obedience for faith. I cannot tell you which of us was more afraid.

stay.text: I helped invite this silence. Walking away would be another prayer without meaning.

rumors.text: Elowen knows the keeper’s face. Ask gently. Some truths look too much like wounds.

veil.text: If mercy has a face, why do I hide from it? Ask Elowen what she saw beneath the chapel.

choices.text: What do you know of the shrine?

bell.text: That bell was made to call souls home. Now its keeper mistakes living feet for answers. Leave the circle before it calls.

dangers.text: The forest dead remember their roads. The crypt dead remember orders. Listen for a pause between them.

shrine.text: The prayer I signed began there. I fear the crystal still knows my handwriting.

boss.text: I can hear my own prayers again. They sound smaller, but more honest.

medicine.text: Mara sells draughts by the square. The blue crystals restore your strength for free. Do not mistake endurance for wisdom.

discovery.text: The forest dead remember their roads. The crypt dead remember orders. Listen for a pause between them. The eastern crypt gate will answer that sigil now.

root.text: You have been here before. Ask the shrine what you chose to forget.

variants.text: The guardian is gone. The shrine can no longer hide your choice from you.
I have not forgotten your cruelty. Speak honestly this time.
The shrine has answered. Hollowmere remembers what you have done. Another question, another thread. Which will you follow?
Another question, another thread. Which will you follow?

choices.text: What do you know of the Veil?
I heard the bell has fallen silent.

identity.text: You may call me Vesper. The name you need is your own. We will come to that.

past.text: I remember a wanderer ringing the first bell. You wore another name then. I will not give it back before you earn it.

choices.text: What do you hear about the others?

town.text: Hollowmere is where endings gather. Kingdoms fall elsewhere; here we learn what survived them.

king.text: Ask the shrine what the king asked the bell to forget.

stay.text: Because you would wake here again. I wanted this time to be different.

rumors.text: The healer remembers what the innkeeper repeats in dreams. Between them, a whole kingdom survives.

veil.text: Beyond the Bellkeeper lies the shrine. Its crystal remembers a choice you have spent your life escaping.

choices.text: What do you know of the shrine?

bell.text: The keeper has mistaken repetition for purpose. Break the pattern: leave its circle, survive the toll, strike the pause.

dangers.text: The forest tests your patience. The crypt tests your fear. Bring the sentinel’s sigil east, and let neither test choose for you.

shrine.text: Beyond the guardian, the crystal keeps your first choice. You were the keeper who rang the bell. This time, you may choose otherwise.

boss.text: The guardian is gone. The shrine can no longer hide your choice from you.

medicine.text: Mara sells draughts by the square. The blue crystals restore your strength for free. Do not mistake endurance for wisdom.

discovery.text: The forest tests your patience. The crypt tests your fear. Bring the sentinel’s sigil east, and let neither test choose for you. The eastern crypt gate will answer that sigil now.

root.text: Beds cost coin. Rumors cost courage. The hounds fear fire.

variants.text: For the first night in years, the sleepers did not scream. Stay for a while.
I have not forgotten your cruelty. Speak honestly this time.
The shrine has answered. Hollowmere remembers what you have done. Your chair is still warm. What is on your mind?
Your chair is still warm. What is on your mind?

choices.text: What do you know of the Veil?
I heard the bell has fallen silent.

identity.text: Nell, keeper of the Last Hearth. Sit near the fire. It still remembers how to be kind.

past.text: My inn used to house traveling players. Their last song is still scratched into a table. Now I rent quiet instead.

choices.text: What do you hear about the others?

town.text: Miners, pilgrims, merchants. Everyone passed through the Last Hearth. I kept their songs; the Veil took their names.

king.text: There is still a room upstairs bearing his crest. Nobody sleeps soundly in it.

stay.text: If the last fire goes out, then we truly have no home.

rumors.text: Ilya visits the well at dawn. Eight names, spoken softly. Never a ninth.

veil.text: It prefers people alone. Rest here if you must; five Crowns buys warmth and a saved night's peace.

choices.text: What do you know of the shrine?

bell.text: A guest once survived by counting the pause after each toll. Step away first. Let the silence tell you when to strike.

dangers.text: Travellers vanished near the southwest hollow. Follow the lamps east, and do not follow any voice calling from the trees.

shrine.text: Vesper speaks of a room without a hearth. Take some warmth with you, if only in memory.

boss.text: For the first night in years, the sleepers did not scream. Stay for a while.

medicine.text: Mara sells draughts by the square. The blue crystals restore your strength for free. Do not mistake endurance for wisdom.
